ivd.interpretation: IVD uses pairwise tournament (Copeland score) to identify the initiator vs victim among source candidates. The initiator is the candidate whose anomaly is least explainable by others and most explanatory for others. Do not select a candidate labeled as 'victim' over one labeled as 'initiator'.

The emitter exception and resource exhaustion in auth plausibly slow authentication calls, causing cascading latency and errors in dependent services. Competing candidates ts-order-other-service and ts-station-service are IVD ambiguous and lack the same initiator strength.
uncertainties: Incomplete trace coverage prevented direct path confirmation, but counterfactual and IVD evidence compensates.

ivd.interpretation: IVD uses pairwise tournament (Copeland score) to identify the initiator vs victim among source candidates. The initiator is the candidate whose anomaly is least explainable by others and most explanatory for others. Do not select a candidate labeled as 'victim' over one labeled as 'initiator'.

results.rationale: ts-route-service is the clear initiator per IVD (Copeland score 7). It has the earliest unambiguous internal failure—a JVM agent error at +4s ('Error opening zip file or JAR manifest missing') and extreme memory/CPU changes near onset. Downstream explanation shows ts-route is a callee of ts-travel, ts-travel2, ts-admin-travel; caller-to-callee traces confirm high-latency requests to ts-route during the incident. These callers exhibit dependency-induced exceptions (500/503 errors) starting after the JVM fault, making them IVD victims. No other candidate—ts-auth, ts-assurance, ts-contacts, ts-preserve—has comparable own-code evidence or IVD initiator status. The late dominant latency drop in ts-route may be a metric artifact but does not weaken the JVM log and IVD consensus. Therefore, ts-route-service JVM agent failure is the root cause.
uncertainties: The latency-90 metric dropping 2831% is extreme and may reflect instrumentation artifact; the actual failure mechanism (JVM agent crash) is well-evidenced by logs
Temporal fragility between ts-route and its callers (onset gaps <10s) is mitigated by request topology and IVD
